youtube_description: Victoria Grant, the young Canadian whose message about how banking and systems of money creation fuel debt and growth has gone viral on the internet, is interviewed by Post Growth's Donnie Maclurcan at the Degrowth in the Americas Conference in Montreal, May 2012; see Victoria's speech here: http://youtu.be/Bx5Sc3vWefE
